title: Motor
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Motor
learningObjectives: Decompose the drawing of a rotating motor into three steps: outline the circle, draw arcs with arc(), and place arrow tips at the arc ends
Explain why translate(), scale(), and rotate() must be applied in that order inside a push()/pop() block to move into the motor's local reference frame
Predict how reversing the direction value flips the circular arrows between clockwise and counter-clockwise rendering
Apply scale() with a single scaleVal parameter so the motor drawing renders correctly at any size without redrawing its geometry
